+def load_image(image_path: str) -> bytes | None:
+    """Load data URLs or objects from the configured storage bucket only."""
+    if not image_path:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if image_path.startswith("data:image"):
+            header, encoded = image_path.split(",", 1)
+            if not header.lower().endswith(";base64"):
+                return None
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
+
+        parsed = urlsplit(image_path)
+        if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc:
+            base = urlsplit(settings.STORAGE_HOST)
+            if (parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https") or
+                    parsed.scheme != base.scheme or parsed.netloc != base.netloc or
+                    parsed.query or parsed.fragment or
+                    not parsed.path.startswith(base.path.rstrip("/") + "/")):
+                return None
+            key = unquote(parsed.path[len(base.path.rstrip("/")) + 1:])
+        else:
+            if parsed.query or parsed.fragment or image_path.startswith("/"):
+                return None
+            key = unquote(parsed.path)
+        if not key or "\\" in key or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")):
+            return None
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        return None

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+from PIL import Image
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def test_exports_report_missing_cuts(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post('/api/v1/projects', headers=headers, json={'title': 'Test', 'genres': []}).json()
+    episode = client.post('/api/v1/episodes', headers=headers, json={
+        'project_id': project['id'], 'title': 'Test', 'episode_order': 1,
+    }).json()
+    image = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new('RGB', (2, 2), 'red').save(image, format='PNG')
+    good = 'data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(image.getvalue()).decode()
+    invalid = 'data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(b'not an image').decode()
+    cuts = []
+    for number, path in [(5, 'http://127.0.0.1/secret'), (1, good), (3, None),
+                         (7, 'missing/object.png'), (9, invalid)]:
+        response = client.post('/api/v1/cuts', headers=headers, json={
+            'episode_id': episode['id'], 'cut_order': number, 'image_path': path,
+        })
+        assert response.status_code == 200
+        cuts.append(response.json())
+    endpoint = f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode['id']}/export"
+    for fmt in ('zip', 'webtoon'):
+        response = client.post(endpoint, headers=headers, params={'format': fmt})
+        assert response.status_code == 200
+        assert response.headers['X-Missing-Cuts'] == '3,5,7,9'
+        if fmt == 'zip':
+            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+                assert archive.read('missing.txt') == b'3\n5\n7\n9\n'
+                assert archive.read('Test_01.png') == image.getvalue()
+    for cut in cuts:
+        assert client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut['id']}", headers=headers, json={'image_path': good}).status_code == 200
+    for fmt in ('zip', 'webtoon'):
+        response = client.post(endpoint, headers=headers, params={'format': fmt})
+        assert response.status_code == 200
+        assert 'X-Missing-Cuts' not in response.headers
+        if fmt == 'zip':
+            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+                assert 'missing.txt' not in archive.namelist()
+
+
+def test_all_missing_exports_report_cuts(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post('/api/v1/projects', headers=headers, json={'title': 'Test', 'genres': []}).json()
+    episode = client.post('/api/v1/episodes', headers=headers, json={
+        'project_id': project['id'], 'title': 'Test', 'episode_order': 1,
+    }).json()
+    client.post('/api/v1/cuts', headers=headers, json={'episode_id': episode['id'], 'cut_order': 2})
+    endpoint = f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode['id']}/export"
+    response = client.post(endpoint, headers=headers, params={'format': 'zip'})
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers['X-Missing-Cuts'] == '2'
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+        assert archive.namelist() == ['missing.txt']
+        assert archive.read('missing.txt') == b'2\n'
+    response = client.post(endpoint, headers=headers, params={'format': 'webtoon'})
+    assert response.status_code == 400

+    key = storage.upload_image(image_bytes, "test", "image")

+    ai = BaseAIService.__new__(BaseAIService)
+    for path in (key, f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}", data_url):
+        assert load_image(path) == image_bytes
+        assert ai._download_image(path) == image_bytes
+        assert reference_board.download_image(path).size == (2, 2)
+    for path in ("http://127.0.0.1/secret", "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+                 f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}.evil.invalid/{key}",
+                 f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}@evil.invalid/{key}",
+                 "//evil.invalid/image", "file:///etc/passwd"):
+        assert load_image(path) is None
+        assert ai._download_image(path) is None
+        assert reference_board.download_image(path) is None
